derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G461 (ἀνορθόω);
def: a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation)

occurrences.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
